Generation contract:
python tests/fixtures/scripts/gen_gateway_response_vectors.py \
  --output tests/fixtures/gateway_response_vectors.v0.1.json

The generator constructs dagr-mcp's own GovernedCallResponse / GovernedDecision /
BusinessResult / ReceiptHandle / CancellationFacts objects and serializes each via
GovernedCallResponse.to_dict(). The committed regression test requires byte-identical
regeneration from those producer classes.

The vector family covers admitted result/error/exception/timeout/cancellation/task-
submitted, refused, deferred, and the service contract's non-coerced unsupported-
lifecycle response (decision=None). It is intentionally product-neutral and carries no
Counterplayer, research, provider-search, provider-open, identity-resolution,
acquisition, or corpus semantics. Cross-repo consumers may interpret only the neutral
gateway facts they own.
